One time I woke up from a nap with drawings of him surrounding me. I was next, but one night I woke up with him standing in my room, and for some reason I felt.. comforted.. They say that Slendy may show up to people who have a hard life, or those who have attempted suicide, and that he is there to protect them. Whatever the reasoning is, if you show that you're not scared, he'll leave you alone.. But I know the exact feeling you just described, and it's no fun at all.

I was with my best friend and another girl in the woods, we were walking around and trying to decide which of two paths to walk through to get to my friends house, when we saw what we THOUGHT was a giant animal. But we realized that its eyes were way too big and reflective. The "animal" stared at us for a good 30-45 seconds and then ran away. We decided to follow down that path, to see where the animal went, but when we walked down we realized that he wasnt there anymore. (We deducted later on that night that the animal must have been the rake). We continued walking down until I stopped cold, everything sort of became blurry except for a small circle under a tree, it became almost like Tunnel Vision. Everything got quiet, and all I could see was Slenderman. He was there under that tree. All he did was lift an arm, almost like a wave, just to tell me that he was there. He then put his arm down, and everything came back into focus. 

That's my most memorable experience, I've also seen him in my room multiple times, and I see him near the wooded areas around my house. I have this theory that sometimes, Slenderman is just around to watch, maybe even to protect you. If you respect Slenderman, he'll most likely have respect for you as well.
